file_insights.purpose: Added comprehensive ruff linter and formatter configuration

patterns_discovered.description: Configuration includes Django-specific rule (DJ) and excludes Django common directories (migrations, staticfiles, media)
Uses per-file-ignores to allow exceptions in specific contexts (tests, init files, settings)
Includes 26 rule sets covering code style, security, imports, type hints, and Django patterns
Configuration aligns with Black formatter defaults (line-length 88, double quotes)

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Mutable class attributes allowed in Django
gotchas_discovered.description: RUF012 is ignored because mutable class attributes are common in Django models
gotchas_discovered.impact: May allow code patterns that could cause unexpected behavior in other contexts

gotchas_discovered.description: PLR2004 is ignored globally, making debugging magic numbers potentially harder
gotchas_discovered.impact: Could reduce code clarity when magic numbers are used in business logic

gotchas_discovered.description: PLR0913 is ignored due to Django views commonly having many parameters
gotchas_discovered.impact: May mask refactoring opportunities for overly complex functions

gotchas_discovered.description: F405 is ignored in config/settings/*.py for star imports
gotchas_discovered.impact: Reduces clarity about which dependencies are being imported from configuration modules

approach_outcome.description: Comprehensive ruff configuration successfully created for Django project
achievements: Configured 26 different rule sets for comprehensive code quality checks
Set appropriate line length (88 characters) compatible with Black
Created per-file-ignore rules for tests, init files, and settings
Configured isort for consistent import ordering
Configured formatter with consistent style (double quotes, space indents)

recommendations.rationale: Several rules are ignored for Django compatibility (RUF012, PLR0913, PLR2004). Should document why these are necessary in team documentation
Consider reducing ignored rules over time as codebase is refactored. Could enable stricter checks in new code while ignoring in legacy code
Configuration is comprehensive but would benefit from automatic enforcement via pre-commit hooks to prevent rule violations in commits
Allowing star imports in settings files may hide problematic dependencies. Consider using explicit imports instead
Functions with many parameters are common in Django views but may benefit from refactoring. Track violations separately to identify improvement opportunities
